postboxMailboxMove.heading: Move this mailbox to Owlat
postboxMailboxMove.loadError: We couldn't load your move status just now. Please refresh to try again.
postboxMailboxMove.pitch: Right now {address} lives on your old provider and Owlat syncs a copy. Moving it here makes Owlat the real home for {address}: you keep the same address, get hosted sending, and your old account stays as a read-only archive — nothing is deleted.
postboxMailboxMove.pace: This is a staged move you drive at your own pace. You can pause between steps, and nothing about how you read mail changes until you finish it.

paused.title: Move paused
paused.body: Nothing is happening until you resume. Your mailbox keeps working exactly as before.

stage1.title: 1. Provision the hosted mailbox
stage1.self: Create the Owlat-hosted mailbox for {address}. It stays empty until you point your domain's mail here in the next step.
stage1.awaitingAdmin: We've asked an admin to set up the hosted mailbox for {address}. This step unlocks as soon as they do — you'll see it move on automatically.

stage2.title: 2. Point your domain's mail at Owlat
stage2.body: Update your domain so new messages arrive directly in Owlat. If someone else manages your domain, you can send them the technical details below.
stage2.recordIntro: Add this MX record for {domain} at your DNS provider. Changing MX needs DNS access — if that's your admin's job, hand them this exact record:
stage2.pointsHere: Mail for {domain} now points at Owlat.
stage2.notPointing: Not pointing here yet — DNS can take a while to propagate. Checked {checked}.
stage2.afterMx: Once the MX record points at Owlat, new mail lands directly in your hosted mailbox. Then archive your old account below.
stage2.noInboundHost: This instance has no inbound mail host configured, so it can't receive mail yet. An admin needs to set that up under Delivery before you can finish the move.
stage2.delivered: Mail for {domain} is delivered through Owlat.
stage2.locked: Available once the hosted mailbox is ready.

stage3.title: 3. Archive your old account
stage3.body: Stop syncing from your old provider and keep everything it already brought in as a read-only archive. Your old mail stays fully searchable — nothing is deleted. Last synced: {lastSync}.
stage3.warning: Do this only after mail for {domain} points at Owlat, so no message slips through the gap.
stage3.done: Done. {address} now lives on Owlat, and your old account is a read-only archive — its history is still here and searchable.
stage3.locked: The final step, once mail points here.

rollback.body: {lead} Cancel any time before you archive. Point your domain's mail back at your old provider and nothing is lost — the hosted mailbox we set up is removed and your original account keeps working untouched.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this move?
cancelDialog.description: We'll remove the hosted mailbox we set up and leave your original account exactly as it is — still connected and syncing. Point your domain's mail back at your old provider if you changed it. Nothing is lost.

notifyAbout.label: Notify me about
notifyAbout.hint: Which new mail pops a desktop notification. "People & important only" uses smart categories to stay quiet about newsletters and automated mail.

badgeAll.label: Count all mail in the badge
badgeAll.hint: When off, the dock/taskbar unread badge counts only people & important mail — keeping the number focused even when notifications are quiet. On by default.

screener.label: Screen first-time senders
screener.hint: When on, mail from someone you've never corresponded with is held out of the Reply Queue until you accept the sender — their mail still lands in the inbox. Keeps triage focused on people you know. Off by default.

postboxOfflineSettings.heading: On this device

store.label: Store recent mail on this device
store.hint: Keeps your inbox list and recently-read messages readable instantly and without a connection. Only sanitized mail is stored, unencrypted, in this browser's local database — leave it off on shared computers.
store.defaultDesktop: On by default in the desktop app.
store.defaultBrowser: Off by default in the browser.

postboxOfflineSettings.writesDisabled: Local storage is full or unavailable — new mail isn't being cached on this device. Clearing the cache may help.

clear.label: Clear local cache
clear.hint: Wipe every thread row and message body cached on this device.

postboxQuickActionsBar.deleteForeverTitle: Permanently delete — frees storage and cannot be undone
